N(S): the set of vertices in Y adjacent to at least one vertex of S
matching: a set of edges no two of which share an endpoint
saturating X: incident with every vertex of X
A: a nonempty proper subset of X with neighborhood cardinality equal to its own cardinality
H: the subgraph induced by the left part A and right part N(A)
K: the subgraph induced by the left part X minus A and right part Y minus N(A)
M_1: a matching in H saturating A
M_2: a matching in K saturating X minus A
G': the graph obtained from G by deleting the vertices x and y
X': the left part X minus {x} of G'
Y': the right part Y minus {y} of G'
M': a matching in G' saturating X'
